sql: SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.duration, l.amount, a.date FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date LIKE '1993%' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND a2.date LIKE '1993%')
